# YNAB API contract (test fixture)

`openapi.yaml` is YNAB API v1.88.0, copied unchanged from
<https://github.com/ynab/ynab-sdk-js/blob/main/open_api_spec.yaml> (Apache-2.0).
It is a real-world regression contract: named nullable schemas, `allOf` with
`nullable` siblings, `allOf` required-overlays, and single-field wrapper bodies.
